decision.summary: Two regions merit closer inspection: (1) a sharp multi-sample jump around indices 618–624 indicating a likely permanent displacement, and (2) a prolonged high-magnitude phase from ~690 to 729 with complex cross-axis morphology suggesting superposed or ambiguous motion. No other windows show similarly distinctive morphological features.

regions.observation: Abrupt multi-sample shift in all axes around index 620–624: N jumps from ~1.5 to ~12, E from ~-3.6 to ~0.7, U from ~-21.6 to ~-13.8; appears as a permanent offset with no clear return within the window.

Sustained high-amplitude motion in N/E/U from ~index 690 onward, with large scatter and apparent platform-like behavior in U (stabilizing near -17 to -18), while N and E show irregular but bounded variation; possible opposing or superposed changes visible in overlapping windows near 700–720.
